t: Conveyors can be used to transport items, entities and fluids. They can interact with the world using $(l:conveyor_upgrades)upgrades$(). Items and entities can go up and down on the conveyors but fluids can only go horizontal. $(br2)Conveyors can be colored by right-clicking them with a dye.
传送带可用于运输物品、实体与流体。通过安装$(l:conveyor_upgrades)升级卡$()，传送带可与世界交互。物品与实体可在传送带上垂直移动，而流体仅能水平流动。$(br2)传送带可通过右击染料进行染色。
Using glowstone can make the conveyors move items and entities very fast.
使用荧石可使传送带以极快速度运送物品与实体。
Using plastic will prevent items from being picked up when they are on top of a conveyor.
使用塑料片可防止物品在传送带上时被自动拾取。
